AOV = kp:AverageOrderValue, the governed metric defined as total sales divided by order count. For calendar year 2023 I resolve it to its binding `sales.sales_performance.average_order_value` and filter to 2023 (a complete year — data coverage runs 2015-01-01 .. 2024-04-20, so no partial-year caveat applies):

run: sales_performance -> { where: DT.year = @2023; aggregate: average_order_value }

The figure this returns is the official 2023 average order value; the definition applied is the global/sales-governed one, not a hand-computed sales/orders ratio.

Basis: kp:AverageOrderValue (governed) | Freshness: 2023-12-31 (full calendar year 2023; dataset max_date 2024-04-20) | Steward: sales
